_README: Pick a market (country), then leave titles/filters to profile.json. Change "market" to any id in markets/ (AE, GB, US, DE, IN, SA, …) or pass --market XX at fetch time. Cities/boards here override the market defaults when set.
_market: AE = UAE (default). Also: GB, US, DE, IN, SA. See markets/README.md to add more.

boards._note: MENA board (UAE/KSA). Skipped automatically for markets without baytCountry. Apify only.
Country taken from markets/<id>.json → indeedCountryCode / jobspyCountryIndeed.
Apify preferred; JobSpy is the free fallback.

_cities: Omit this key to use markets/<id>.json cities. To override, set e.g. "cities": [{ "where": "London", "radiusKm": 40 }]

filters._titlePatterns: Pulled from profile.search.includeTitlePatterns / excludeTitlePatterns at runtime. Do not hardcode a profession here.
